For dark subjects use charcoal #1B1E26 and slate surfaces #272D38 with legible pale tokens and the same blue accent. Familiar system sans typography and monospace only for source. Crisp 1px dividers, 6px corner radii, 8px spacing increments, no decorative gradients, no glass, no giant cards, no marketing art, no invented logo. Preserve the real Markdown-editor identity and useful commands. This is a proposed static design concept, not a working product. Show one option only, with readable exact short labels and synthetic research-note content.
